Gpix · Health data

Gpix reads only the steps, active calories and heart rate you authorize in Health Connect, for the period of a selected walk.

Reading starts when you tap “Add watch measurements”. These measurements enrich the walk saved on your phone and are synced with your personal API so you can access them on other phones.

Health data is never used for advertising. Gpix does not write data to Health Connect.

You can revoke permissions in Health Connect at any time. This stops new reads; imported values remain in walks until you delete them from Gpix history.
